# Liliana Canedo Portillo — licapor.dev

> Portfolio of Liliana Canedo Portillo (Li), Senior Software Engineer at Tech Benders with 8+ years building digital products across EdTech, AdTech, hospitality, and e-commerce. She specializes in applied AI (agents, MCP servers, agentic workflows on top of LLMs) alongside React/Next.js frontend and product engineering.

The site is available in Spanish (default) and English (under /en/).

## Key pages

- [Home (ES)](https://licapor.dev/): positioning, featured work, clients, career timeline (roles, dates, education), contact
- [Home (EN)](https://licapor.dev/en/)

## Case studies (Lottus Education — multi-tenant EdTech SaaS)

- [Sistema de Gestión Documental](https://licapor.dev/projects/gestion-documental): digital student records for 80,000 users; Bubble → React/Next.js migration
- [Sistema de Evaluación Docente](https://licapor.dev/projects/evaluacion-docente): faculty evaluation periods for 6K faculty / 80K students
- [Automatización de Titulación](https://licapor.dev/projects/titulacion): degree and certification automation, 75% faster processing

English versions live under https://licapor.dev/en/projects/…
